easyPrerequisites:
Soul Diviner doesn't have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it and removing the flying counter from the additional creature, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat
